pages.text: Everything in CyberFarm runs on $(l)FE$() (Forge Energy): the Drone Assembler builds with it and the Drone Dock charges your drones with it. These machines make that power, and since FE is the standard, generators from other mods work just as well.

$(li)$(l)1$(): $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l), any furnace fuel, 40 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l), Biogas, 60 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l), Methane, 160 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)2.5$(): $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l) (1-4 cylinders), Biogas, 90-360 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)2.5$(): $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l) (1-4 cylinders), Methane, 150-600 FE/t
pages.title: Power tiers

pages.text: $(li)$(l)3$(): $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) + $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbine$(/l), Uranium Fuel Rods, up to 9,600 FE/t per turbine

$(li)$(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l): about 6 mB/t of Biogas from compostables and rotten flesh, a farm to feed it$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l): 25 mB/t of Methane from a zombie (12 other monsters, 4 animals), a 3x3x4 chamber, acid, a steady supply of mobs
pages.title: Where the gas comes from

pages.text: A zombie chamber is the big step: about $(l)200 FE/t$() in a Gas Turbine, as much as ten Bio-Digesters. A full four-cylinder Steam Engine burns the methane of two or three chambers into 600 FE/t, more than a whole row of Combustion Generators, but still less than the smallest reactor at full power.

Start with a $(l)Combustion Generator$() and coal. When you want power that does not need you to shovel fuel, move on to $(l:generators/gas_power)Gas Power$(/l): a $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l) turns farm waste into Biogas and a $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) draws Methane from a captured mob dissolving in $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid$(/l), both burned by the Gas Turbine. For more
power from the same gases, build a $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l) with up to four cylinders.

The most powerful option is in the $(l:nuclear/nuclear)Nuclear$(/l) section: a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) burning uranium $(l:nuclear/uranium)Fuel Rods$(/l) makes steam for $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbines$(/l), cooled with the help of the $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l). Its waste must be treated in a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l), or the area turns $(l:nuclear/radiation)radioactive$(/l).
Generators push their FE into adjacent machines by themselves; to reach machines further away, use $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l).
